## Quarto

Quarto enables you to weave together content and executable code into a finished document. To learn more about Quarto see <https://quarto.org>.

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(palmerpenguins) #import libraries and data 

penguins |> group_by(species) |> summarize(bill_len = mean(bill_length_mm, na.rm = TRUE)) # summary table 
penguins
# data plot
ggplot(penguins, mapping = aes(x = bill_length_mm, y = body_mass_g)) + geom_point() 
```
